body:
Execution parent: #101. Architecture roadmap: #82. Cross-repository counterpart: joshyorko/homebrew-tools#103 is CLOSED and handled by Joshua Yorko. Do not reopen or duplicate the completed tap migration.

The Actions-side generator still targets Sema4AI/homebrew-tools/actions/workflows/publish.yml and Sema4AI/Robocorp CDN/S3 infrastructure. Updating the tap did not update this caller.

Evidence:
- .github/workflows/_gen_workflows.py: ActionServerBinaryRelease.trigger_brew_workflow_job_part(), upload_to_s3(), and ActionServerRuntimeRecovery.binary_recovery_release_steps().
- Legacy CDN /action-server/releases/1.0.1/linux64/action-server is an unrelated 2024-09-26 object (158556587 bytes); the community Runtime 1.0.1 Linux binary is 81666089 bytes. Matching version.txt is not artifact identity.
- The community tap now serves the correct Runtime 1.0.1 assets/hashes through its own pipeline.
- Published community binaries: https://github.com/joshyorko/actions/releases/tag/actions-runtime-1.0.1
- PyPI Runtime is now 1.0.2 (metadata/template patch); standalone GitHub binaries remain 1.0.1. Do not imply native 1.0.2 was published.

Scope:
- Reconcile the Actions-side caller with the tap's live workflow/input contract (tap-manual.yml action/package_id or tap-auto-update.yml slot_id, subject to current readback).
- Use the intended community release surface; decide explicitly whether legacy S3/CDN delivery is retired or replaced with an owned target. Do not overwrite unrelated legacy version objects.
- Reuse existing delivery helpers. Do not introduce a generic release framework.
- Bind the handoff to actual native assets, exact version/source, and downloaded hashes. Preserve unsigned labeling and fail-closed partial signing configuration.
- Document and safely handle already-published releases so a handoff failure does not require replacing assets or repeating builds/PyPI upload.

Acceptance: no community native release accidentally dispatches Sema4AI's tap or publishes into unrelated legacy version paths; the agreed owned handoff is verified externally with exact hashes/workflow IDs; package-vs-native versions are presented accurately; no tag replacement or unnecessary rebuild. Status: OPEN; target/caller alignment remains Actions-owned. The completed Homebrew issue is not a blocker.
title: fix(release): align Actions-side native handoffs with community distribution
